personal.headline: Trajectory & Flight Dynamics
personal.summary: Trajectory engineer with a focus on numerically stable orbital mechanics and verification of critical mission software. Strong preference for documented, auditable derivations over clever shortcuts.

experiences.title: Senior Trajectory Engineer
bullets: Derived and hand-verified the orbital insertion and re-entry trajectories for three consecutive crewed missions, each of which completed without any in-flight trajectory correction beyond nominal planned burns.

Authored the mission-critical verification procedures that every future on-board flight computer output is checked against; the procedure catalog has been used without modification on four subsequent vehicles over the last eight years of the program.

Led a three-engineer sub-team responsible for cross-checking thirty-plus pages of trajectory equations against independent hand calculations, catching two numerically unstable intermediate steps before the equations were committed to a flight computer.

experiences.title: Computer (Research Mathematician)
bullets: Produced wind-tunnel data reductions and flight-research computations supporting nine separate aerodynamic research programs; work was delivered on the schedule negotiated with the principal investigators in every reporting period.
Trained four junior mathematicians on the internal computation procedures and the quality-assurance checklist; two of the four went on to lead trajectory sub-teams within three years of joining.
Identified and corrected a persistent sign error in a widely circulated internal computation template; the corrected template has been the departmental standard since.
